title: Color / UI palette — PMS references

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: PMS

slide_intent: Maintain the identity of an interface palette when referencing it in print, because a named color system can cross media without losing its roles.
strategic_value: The UI subset’s Pantone mappings can support consistent physical references to IBM’s digital experience.
demonstration: The PMS tab pairs the blue and gray ramps and four alert swatches with print-reference names or numbers.
practical_value: Look up a UI color’s supplied Pantone reference for a print representation of the palette.
